description: Partial update of an existing webhook. Pass only the fields you want to change. Pass `secret: null` to clear the signing secret. Once changed, signatures are computed with the new value — update the receiver accordingly.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

project_ids.description: Full set of projects whose monitoring events go to this webhook — the list replaces the previous one. Omitted, the set stays as it was. An empty array switches monitoring events off entirely; account events keep arriving.

name: webhook_update
title: Update webhook
